candidates.hook_ar: نفس السطر. نفس الكاميرا. شنو تغيّر؟
candidates.gloss_en: Same line, same camera. What changed?
candidates.tension: What did the card with a hole change?
candidates.first_frame: Defocused printed line; black card with a ~1 mm hole enters from the right; the line becomes readable (optics demo, labelled)
candidates.continuation: Control: the same card without a hole changes nothing
candidates.payoff: Mechanism: smaller aperture, smaller blur spots; costs light

beats.new_info: line sharpens when the holed card enters
beats.spoken: نفس السطر. نفس الكاميرا. شنو تغيّر؟

beats.new_info: the same card without a hole changes nothing; the hole is the variable
beats.spoken: الورقة بدون ثقب ما تسوي شي. الثقب هو الفرق.

beats.new_info: each object point becomes a blur spot; a narrow aperture makes the spot smaller
beats.spoken: كل نقطة تصير بقعة مشوشة، والثقب يضيّق الشعاع فتصغر البقعة.

beats.new_info: less light reaches the sensor/eye, so the image is dimmer
beats.spoken: وتدفع ثمنها: ضوء أقل، فالصورة تصير أغمق.

beats.new_info: this is an optics demo not an eye test; clinics use a specific size
beats.spoken: هذا شرح بصريات مو فحص نظر. وبالعيادة يستعملون حجم معيّن — ليش؟

claims.text: A small aperture can make blur from a focusing error look sharper
claims.support_quote: people with a refractive error, such as myopia, can usually see better with the pinhole
claims.scope: clinical pinhole test; refractive error; shown here with a defocused camera as an optics analogy

claims.text: Decreasing pupil size increases depth of focus
claims.support_quote: Decreasing pupil size increases the depth of focus

candidates.risk: A camera's defocus is an analogy, not the viewer's eye

candidates.hook_ar: تصغّر ثقب الورقة تشوف أحدّ… وتصغّره أكثر يصير أسوأ. ليش؟
candidates.gloss_en: Make the hole smaller and you see sharper... smaller still and it gets worse. Why?
candidates.tension: Why would a smaller hole be worse?
candidates.first_frame: Three cards with holes of decreasing size photographed through the same defocused lens; the smallest is dark and soft
candidates.payoff: Why ~1.2 mm is the working size

beats.new_info: a middle hole is sharp; a tiny hole is darker and softer
beats.spoken: تصغّر ثقب الورقة تشوف أحدّ… وتصغّره أكثر يصير أسوأ. ليش؟

beats.new_info: the smallest hole looks worse than the middle one on camera
beats.spoken: شوف: الثقب الأصغر أغمق وأنعم من الوسط.

beats.new_info: below about 0.75 mm diffraction blurs the image again and the view darkens
beats.spoken: تحت حدود ٠.٧٥ ملم، الضوء ينثني على الحافة فالصورة تتشوّش مرة ثانية.
عيادات النظر تستقر على حوالي ١.٢ ملم.
بالبصريات دايماً اكو ثمن لكل تحسين.

claims.text: Clinical pinhole is about 1.2 mm; smaller apertures add diffraction blur
claims.support_quote: if the pinhole aperture is smaller than 1.2 millimeters, the blurring effects of diffraction
claims.scope: clinical pinhole for refractive-error assessment; Whitney 2009 tested 0.5-1.5 mm; Kim 2014 reports blur below ~0.75 mm

claims.text: Apertures below ~0.75 mm cause considerable diffraction blurring
claims.support_quote: aperture size smaller than 0.75 mm causes considerable diffraction blurring

candidates.risk: Hard to film the three sizes legibly (marked UNFILMABLE if the smallest hole is not visible on camera)

candidates.hook_ar: نفس الثقب يحسّن النظر عند ناس، ويخليه أسوأ عند ناس آخرين.
candidates.gloss_en: The same pinhole improves sight for some people and makes it worse for others.
candidates.tension: Why does the same hole help some people and not others?
candidates.first_frame: Clinician-style hand holding a pinhole occluder in front of an eye-chart line, then a second line that does not improve; on-screen text `ليش؟`
candidates.continuation: If blur is from focusing error it improves; some eye conditions do not

beats.new_info: the same device gives opposite results
beats.spoken: نفس الثقب يحسّن النظر عند ناس، ويخليه أسوأ عند ناس آخرين.

beats.new_info: with a focusing error, acuity usually improves through the hole
beats.spoken: إذا التشويش من التركيز، الثقب يساعد.

beats.new_info: with macular disease or lens opacities the pinhole may not help or may worsen
beats.spoken: وإذا اكو مشكلة بالشبكية أو العدسة، ممكن ما يساعد أو يخرّب.

beats.new_info: the result is a clue under controlled conditions that guides the next test
beats.spoken: الدكتور يستعمله كمؤشر، وبعدها يكمّل الفحص.

beats.new_info: a home attempt cannot tell you which case you are
beats.spoken: وبالبيت ما تگدر تعرف أنت أي حالة. الفحص هو الجواب.

claims.text: Through a pinhole, vision improves with refractive error and may be unchanged or worse with macular disease
claims.support_quote: Worse vision might indicate macular diseases or lens opacities
claims.scope: pinhole test discussion in a keratoconus paper; WHO uses it in rapid surveys; not accurate for estimating post-refraction acuity

claims.text: Individuals with macular disease may have similar or even reduced acuity through a pinhole
claims.support_quote: may have similar or even reduced acuity through a pinhole
claims.scope: clinical teaching document; macular and other central-vision disease

candidates.risk: Could be misread as a self-test; closing beat must hold
